summary: The document describes code for handling cascading dropdowns in a web application.
purpose: To manage the visibility of dropdown controls and replace them with static text when needed.

workflows.name: Replace Dropdown with Static Text
steps: Locate the dropdown control using the given name.
Set the dropdown control's visibility to false.
Locate the literal control using the given name.
Set the literal control's visibility to true.

business_rules: Disabled cascading dropdowns are not loaded and should not display their selected value.
conditions: Dropdown and literal controls must be found within the container.
exceptions: If the dropdown or literal control is not found, no changes are made.
